title: fix(app-shell): Studio pillar loads and the metadata item editor open no buffer over a draft the server refuses to read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6XXaS1k5WoFSG9mHkAJSe5)_

Fixes #29148 (PR 2 of 2, the split the claim amendment 6574316242 records; PR 1 #29275 landed the four editors at 192c15cf).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6574269114) and its amendment (comment 6574316242).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 的 Interfaces 应用导航、Data 对象及其在配对包里的扩展、Automations 流程，以及元数据项编辑页（加载与发布后的重读），读草稿遇到服务器 403（草稿带受众门 `requiredPermissions`，作者无权读）时，不再当成"没有草稿"去打开已发布版本：不装编辑缓冲，不发任何保存，显示同一条拒绝说明，服务器原话放在"详情"里。`StudioRefusalStrip` 移到独立模块，元数据项编辑页画的就是 Studio 那一条。
- 为什么改：之前这些入口会把已发布版本当作编辑起点，下一次保存把它写成草稿，悄悄抹掉草稿里的权限门和其他未发布改动。PR 1 修了四个编辑器，本 PR 修剩下的加载点，完成 #29148。
- 风险与回滚：只影响草稿读取返回 403 的项；无草稿、可读草稿、其他读取失败的路径不变。元数据项编辑页对这样的项不提供任何写操作（保存、发布、丢弃、重置、删除），直到草稿可读。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ResourceEditPage.tsx` 的 `draftRefused` 状态、加载与 `doPublish` 两处 `'refused' in draftRead` 分支和提前返回；`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 四处同样的分支；新模块 `StudioRefusalStrip.tsx`（内容原样搬移）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`readDraftForSave` hands a draft read refused `403` back as `refused` (#29132). The remaining loads that installed a buffer from that answer now act on it the way the Interfaces leaf load (#29015) and PR 1's four editors do: no buffer and no pin are installed, the `engine.studio.refusal.draftUnreadable` sentence shows with the server's own sentence (`formatMetadataError`) behind Details, and nothing is sent. No new i18n key.

- `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, Interfaces pillar, app nav load: a refused app draft installs no nav buffer (`appDraftFor` stays unloaded, so the nav autosave's target is never loaded), the pillar reads it as a failed load with the strip, and Edit nav is not offered. No leaf opens under the unread navigation.
- Data pillar, object load: a refused object draft leaves `objDraftFor` unloaded, so the designer shows the strip in place of the object and its autosave has nothing to send. On the draft-only path the published layers are not read to stand in for it.
- Data pillar, object-extension load (a base's pair, #28575): a refused extension draft installs no extension buffer, so neither Add field door (the Form toolbar's, the Records grid's "+") is offered and no extension save is sent over the draft.
- Automations pillar, flow load: a refused flow draft leaves `draftFor` unloaded; the strip shows in place of the canvas and the enable switch.
- `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, load (:1344) and the re-read after a publish (:2250): a refused read sets the new `draftRefused` state instead of installing a buffer or recording a pin. `canWrite` is false while it is set, so every write the page offers is withheld, and the page renders the strip in its shell in place of the editor (the same early return the loading state uses).
- `studio-design/StudioRefusalStrip.tsx`: `StudioRefusalStrip` moved out of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` unchanged, so `ResourceEditPage` draws the same strip. `StudioDesignSurface` re-exports it for its pins (`refusalAnnounced-29139`); `index.ts` still does not.

Unchanged on purpose: the verdict-only re-reads in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (they install nothing), and PR 1's four editors, which keep their own refusal hosts.

## Tests

Three new files; each refused case has a control (no pending draft: the published body opens, and where the harness saves, the first save is pinned `If-None-Match: *`).

- `StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (6): app nav, object and flow, each refused plus control, over the server double of `servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765`.
- `DataPillar.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (2): the object-extension load over the #28575 harness, refused plus control (Add field saves at the pair).
- `ResourceEditPage.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (3): the load refused, the post-publish re-read refused, and the control.

Ablation, one per site (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, guard turned into `false && …`, restore proven blob == HEAD): each site's refused case goes red, every other case stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- PR 1's four editors were not switched to the shared strip: each already renders the same message and Details in its own host with its own test id, and switching them is a churn-only change outside this PR's sites.
- `ResourceEditPage` withholds every write for an item whose draft read is refused, discard and publish included: the page cannot show what those would act on.
- Changed lines 972 (+907/-65): 239 in source (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 118, most of its removed lines being the strip that moved; `StudioRefusalStrip.tsx` 72, the moved strip; `ResourceEditPage.tsx` 49), 721 in the three new test files, 12 in the changeset.
